name: carousel-path-5-vertical
title: Path Carousel 5 (vertical)
description: Vertical image cards ride an open bezier path (arc, V, diagonal, wave, S-curve) with depth scaling and tangent rotation (Path style 5); 24 image slots, the curve rebuilt for the 780 field. Images and speed are variables; placement full (brand ground), top or bottom; runs or fades out.
